title: Extract a shared renderer and add an SMS notice
goal: Refactor shop.notify so the three email_* functions share one private _render helper without changing their output, and add sms_receipt.
acceptance_criteria:
_render(subject, line, name) returns 'Subject: <subject>

Hello <Name Title-Cased and stripped>,
<line>
Thanks!' and all three email_* functions use it
the output of email_receipt, email_shipping and email_refund is byte-for-byte unchanged
sms_receipt(name, order_id, total) returns 'Hi <Name Title-Cased and stripped>: order <order_id> total <total with 2 decimals>'
an SMS longer than 40 characters is cut to its first 39 characters followed by the single character '…'
shop/templates.py is not modified and the public function names stay
